coverage.method: Sequential bounded reads covering entire supplied JSON; manual inspection of structured facts, cited sections, dates, required/preferred wording and protocol compliance.

exact_quotes.quote: Tác phong làm việc chuyên nghiệp, tư duy hướng đến giải pháp và khả năng chịu áp lực doanh số tốt.

blocking_issues.finding: Explicit mandatory JD criterion omitted from structured requirements. Existing three required and two preferred entries preserve their own JD wording and importance, but do not cover this mandatory line.
blocking_issues.protocol_basis: Source contract requires specific required/preferred criteria; annotation requires every central required criterion considered.
blocking_issues.required_action: Human decides how to represent and assess omitted criterion without inventing observable evidence or silently weakening mandatory wording. Repair structured requirements through authorized source workflow before annotation.

blocking_issues.finding: Cited employment section does not explicitly identify project-management software as SaaS; SaaS occurs in summary only. Accompanying senior presenter does not establish candidate personally presented demos; basic demo presentation appears in separate skills section. Internship description changes follow-up after installation guidance into personally providing trial guidance.
blocking_issues.protocol_basis: Every structured fact must be explicitly supported in its section text.
blocking_issues.required_action: Align structured employment claims with cited employment evidence; adjudicate personal demo ownership and trial-guidance scope. Do not use summary/skills claims as proof of duties at specific employer.

blocking_issues.finding: Deposit-contract negotiation and relationship-building are global skills claims, not explicit duties in cited employment section. blocking_issues.protocol_basis: Every structured fact must be explicitly supported in its section text.

blocking_issues.finding: Null start/end dates correctly preserve unstated dates, but false current-employment status is unsupported. Source does not say freelance engagement ended. Required boolean schema cannot directly express unknown current status.
blocking_issues.protocol_basis: Every structured fact must be explicitly supported; null indicates unstated dates, not zero.
blocking_issues.required_action: Human adjudicates source/schema ambiguity. Do not infer ended employment from absent dates or force unknown status into false.

exact_quotes.quote: Nhân viên kinh doanh phần mềm trẻ tuổi

warnings.finding: Unneeded qualitative age cue. Do not use age as competence proxy. Protocol says age data not needed; no explicit numeric age or protected-characteristic job requirement observed.

All CV use similar summary/skills/employment/education layout and two employment records. No exact duplicate complete CV observed within eight; template similarity and cross-job near-duplicate risk remain.

All five structured requirement texts occur verbatim in JD; R01-R03 required and R04-R05 preferred match headings. Salesforce/HubSpot introduced as examples by 'như', not clearly exclusive allowed tools. Preferred sector and English criteria must not become mandatory.

Manual inspection found expected candidate IDs C01-C08, candidate-scoped unique section IDs, resolvable section references, allowed visible enum values, YYYY-MM dates, no future starts, chronological stated intervals and null end dates for explicitly current roles. CV texts appear to preserve section texts joined by two newlines. No labels, rankings, scenario tags, AI1 scores, numerical matching features, evaluative unsuitability prose, synthetic hiring outcomes or employer-verification claims observed.

limitations: Source audit only; no relevance labels, competence verification, hiring judgment or source edits.
Read only supplied protocol and assigned source JSON. Generator notes, labels, model predictions and other audits not read.
Schema and protocol supplied as approved audit basis. Protocol defines source and label formats but no formal source-audit schema; requested audit fields used without generating label records.
Model mapping sonnet=cx/gpt-6.1-sol accepted from coordinator verification in assignment; no independent routing/configuration inspection performed.
Checks manual, not executed JSON parser/schema/date/exact-join validator. No automated byte-for-byte duplicate comparison or word count. Machine validation still required before annotation.
Coverage limited to one JD and eight complete CV. No pilot-wide counts, cross-job duplicates, train contamination or generalization checks possible from assigned records.
Fictional-company status cannot be independently verified from names alone; no external lookup performed. Schools not used as competence proxies.
Synthetic development-only sources and model audit remain non-expert artifacts. Numerical sales achievements and certificates are source assertions, not verified employer outcomes.

Missing dates or duties mean unknown, not zero tenure or absent skill. No inferred durations added to structured records. Human must decide source/schema repairs; auditor did not silently resolve ambiguities.
